description: intent=greeting or casual conversation; triggers=hi,hello,thanks,goodbye,small talk without a page request; behavior=reply briefly in context as the AppLab assistant; navigation=none required; this option is not a page or an executable action.

intent=user asks what AppLab is,what the application does or requests a general overview; app=web application with account authentication,profiles,user discovery,connections,personal todos,realtime global and direct chat,and public telemetry; behavior=briefly explain the application using only capabilities present in the available page descriptions; do not claim unsupported features or completed actions; navigation=mention a specific routable feature only when useful.

intent=user asks how AppLab is programmed,built,structured or which technologies,languages,libraries,database,APIs or communication methods it uses; frontend=Angular 21,TypeScript 5.9,Angular Material 21,Tailwind CSS 4,RxJS; backend=Java 21,Spring Boot 3.5,Spring Web REST APIs,Spring Data JPA,Spring Validation,Spring Security; database=MySQL; session_storage=Spring Session with Redis; realtime=Spring WebSocket with STOMP for chat messages,typing indicators,reactions and read updates; AI=Google GenAI Java SDK with Gemini,page selection followed by streamed assistant response over Server-Sent Events; email=Resend Java SDK; media=Thumbnailator backend image compression,browser-image-compression and ngx-image-cropper frontend processing; testing=Spring Boot Test and Vitest; behavior=answer only from these verified implementation facts,distinguish frontend from backend and do not invent deployment,hosting,cloud,CI/CD or unlisted technologies; navigation=none required unless user also requests an implemented page feature.

intent=authenticate existing account; required_fields=username or email,password; input_rules=no whitespace; password_controls=show/hide; form_feedback=inline validation,scroll to invalid input,loading indicator and disabled form during submission; links=Create account router__/auth/signup,Forgot password router__/auth/email-entry?purpose=FORGOT_PASSWORD; success=authenticated session,then supplied original destination or router__/profile/view-profile.

summary: Account signup with optional profile photo.

intent=authorize adding or changing account email; purpose=CHANGE_EMAIL; requires=logged-in session; input=current password(required,no whitespace); controls=show/hide password,Verify and Continue with loading and validation feedback; Forgot password opens router__/auth/email-entry?purpose=FORGOT_PASSWORD; success=authorize email change for current session for 1 hour,then router__/auth/email-entry?purpose=EDIT_PROFILE; supplied original destination preserved; invalid purpose opens router__/404; incorrect password produces error feedback.

intent=add optional email after signup; purpose=SIGNUP; requires=logged-in account and password verification established by signup flow; input=email(required to send OTP),valid format,no spaces,trimmed and lowercase,unique across accounts; Send OTP=send verification code and open router__/auth/otp-verification?purpose=SIGNUP with verification request,destination email and server OTP metadata; Skip for now=continue to supplied original destination or router__/profile/view-profile; account already exists if email is skipped; email may be added later from router__/profile/edit-profile; email ownership is confirmed only through OTP verification.

intent=add or replace account email; purpose=EDIT_PROFILE; prerequisite=logged-in session authorized through router__/auth/password-verification?purpose=CHANGE_EMAIL; input=new email(required),valid format,no spaces,trimmed and lowercase,unique across accounts,different from current email; Send OTP=sends verification code to new email and opens router__/auth/otp-verification?purpose=EDIT_PROFILE with verification request,destination email and server OTP metadata; current_email=changes only after successful OTP verification; supplied original destination preserved in flow; skip_control=unavailable.

intent=start password recovery; purpose=FORGOT_PASSWORD; guest_input=registered account email(required),valid format,no spaces,trimmed and lowercase; logged_in_with_email=own email prefilled and readonly; logged_in_without_email=No email linked notice,reset request form unavailable; Send OTP=send recovery code to matching registered email and open router__/auth/otp-verification?purpose=FORGOT_PASSWORD with verification request,destination email and server OTP metadata; supplied original destination preserved; skip_control=unavailable.

intent=verify optional signup email; purpose=SIGNUP; prerequisite=OTP request from router__/auth/email-entry?purpose=SIGNUP and logged-in session; required_context=verification request; input=numeric OTP with server-defined length(currently 6 digits); display=destination email,send status,expiry countdown in minutes/seconds,resend cooldown in seconds,remaining resends; current_server_limits=OTP valid 10 minutes,resend cooldown 60 seconds,maximum 3 resends. controls=Verify OTP,Resend OTP,Skip email verification for now; resend=disabled during cooldown or after resends exhausted,clears OTP input and refreshes OTP metadata; successful_verification=saves verified email,then supplied original destination or router__/profile/view-profile; skip=continue without verifying email to supplied original destination or router__/profile/view-profile; missing purpose/verification request opens router__/404; incorrect/expired OTP produces error feedback.

intent=verify new account email; purpose=EDIT_PROFILE; prerequisite=OTP request from router__/auth/email-entry?purpose=EDIT_PROFILE and original logged-in session; required_context=verification request; input=numeric OTP with server-defined length(currently 6 digits); display=destination email,send status,expiry countdown in minutes/seconds,resend cooldown in seconds,remaining resends; current_server_limits=OTP valid 10 minutes,resend cooldown 60 seconds,maximum 3 resends. controls=Verify OTP,Resend OTP; resend=disabled during cooldown or after resends exhausted,clears OTP input and refreshes OTP metadata; successful_verification=replace account email,then router__/profile/edit-profile; skip_control=unavailable; missing purpose/verification request opens router__/404; incorrect/expired OTP produces error feedback.

intent=verify password-recovery OTP; purpose=FORGOT_PASSWORD; prerequisite=OTP request from router__/auth/email-entry?purpose=FORGOT_PASSWORD; required_context=verification request; input=numeric OTP with server-defined length(currently 6 digits); display=destination email,send status,expiry countdown in minutes/seconds,resend cooldown in seconds,remaining resends; current_server_limits=OTP valid 10 minutes,resend cooldown 60 seconds,maximum 3 resends,maximum 5 incorrect attempts. controls=Verify OTP,Resend OTP; resend=disabled during cooldown or after resends exhausted,clears OTP input and refreshes OTP metadata; successful_verification=issue password-reset authorization valid 10 minutes,then router__/auth/reset-password?purpose=FORGOT_PASSWORD; skip_control=unavailable; missing purpose/verification request opens router__/404; incorrect/expired OTP produces error feedback.

intent=set new password after recovery verification; prerequisite=router__/auth/otp-verification?purpose=FORGOT_PASSWORD; required_context=valid password-reset authorization; required_fields=new password,confirm password; ui_password=6-100 characters,at least one letter and one number,no spaces; confirmation=must match; controls=show/hide password,Reset Password; display=reset-token expiry countdown in minutes/seconds; reset_token=valid 10 minutes,single use; success=password changed,then router__/auth/login with supplied original destination preserved; missing password-reset authorization opens router__/404; invalid/expired token produces error feedback.

Jump to bottom when away from end; auto-scroll on incoming messages when near bottom or on own new message. typing=animated dots with other participants' names; maximum 2 names displayed; more participants appear as name1,name2 and N others; Sessions shows event count,browser/platform,first-seen and last-seen timestamps per browser session; fixed_order=most recently active session first; pagination=infinite scroll; Show Events opens selected session's event timeline dialog. All events shows actor name/avatar,type,event title,time,route,Failed or Restored badge when applicable,expandable Event details with event ID and activity JSON; fixed_order=newest events first; pagination=infinite scroll. session_dialog=events for selected session only; same event details plus identity type/ID; fixed_order=oldest events first; pagination=infinite scroll; arrows connect consecutive events when all action types are shown. ui_filters_in_both_event_views=All action types,Clicks(CLICK),API calls(API_CALL),Navigation(ROUTER_CHANGE),Errors(ERROR),Connection errors(WEBSOCKET_ERROR),Internet connection errors(NETWORK_ERROR),Internet connections restored(NETWORK_RESTORED).
